data.exact_reserve_text: This release is a result of the Markel strategy to reserve prudently, more favourable claims development than originally anticipated and the work of our claims department in dealing with claims in an expeditious manner.
data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate reports a prior-year release of GBP 32.4m in 2015 driven by more favourable than anticipated claims development and prudent reserving practice, supported by active claims management. No explicit gross prior-year movement figure was presented; the disclosed GBP 32.4m figure is reported in the narrative and used here as the quantified prior-year movement (a release).
